preconditions.description: The input contains at least one line with the number of test cases T.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.strip().splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: For every test case line, L and R are integers such that 1 <= L <= R <= 10^9.
The number of test case lines matches the integer T given in the first line.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.strip().splitlines()[i]) == (sum(n * len(str(n)) for n in range(int(lines[i+1].split()[0]), int(lines[i+1].split()[1]) + 1)) % 1000000007) for i, lines in enumerate([stdin.strip().splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the i-th output line equals the sum of goodness (n * number_of_digits(n)) for all integers n from L to R inclusive, modulo 1,000,000,007.
